name: corpus-qa
description: Answer questions about a corpus of documents with grounded citations and refusal on insufficient evidence

steps.description: Discover and parse all documents in the corpus (PDF, DOCX, HTML)
Load parsed documents into agent memory (DOCUMENTS section)
steps.note: Use ResearchAgent.load_document() for each parsed document

steps.description: Ask the question using RAG — retrieves relevant passages, generates grounded answer
steps.note: ResearchAgent dispatches to kaos-llm-core RAG program automatically
RAG handles verification internally with configurable match strategies

steps.description: If insufficient evidence, report what's missing and what would help
steps.note: InsufficientEvidence carries attempted_claims and what_would_resolve hints
